title: Great app but would be much better with improvements
body:
Compared to other habit apps in the App Store this has the best look and the ease of use. However I do want to suggest two things that app lacks compared to the other apps. 1. Being able to look forward into future days. Being able to swipe right to look at tomorrow’s tasks and so on. 2. Being able to add notes to each habit in a more accessible way.
3. Being able to add tasks that don’t repeat. 
I hope these functions can be added in the future, I know it will make the experience much better. Thank you!!
